keywords: The Petitioner sought to compel the Respondents to implement or prepare a national policy promulgated for the protection of elephants who live in their natural habitat declared as protected areas under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance by the Government for elephants and other wildlife species; sought to compel the 3rd Respondent to prepare an actionable plan to prevent or minimise future train accidents causing harm to elephants. Held – Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
